title: Traveling Waves in Equity Markets with Rank-Based Entry and Exit
abstract: arXiv:2608.27156v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We model equity markets using geometric Brownian particles entering and exiting at rank-dependent intensities. In the many-firm limit, the capital distribution converges to the solution of a reaction-diffusion equation with reaction term built from the intensities. Calibrated on CRSP data, the reaction term is bistable, and the long-run distribution is a traveling wave: we prove existence, uniqueness, and, for constant coefficients, exponential relaxation. Turnover, not drift, stabilizes the calibrated market. With measured volatility, the wave tracks the empirical capital distribution in every decade, determines the capitalization growth of diversity-weighted portfolios, and places the market just inside the boundary of the diverse phase. Turnover reclaims most of what rebalancing gains.

translated_title: 基于排名进入与退出的股票市场中的行波现象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27156v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们使用几何布朗粒子来建模股票市场，这些粒子以依赖于排名的强度进入和退出市场。在众多公司的极限情况下，资本分布收敛于一个带有由强度构建的反应项的反应-扩散方程的解。基于CRSP数据校准后，反应项是双稳态的，长期分布表现为行波：我们证明了存在性、唯一性，并在常数系数情况下证明了指数松弛。换手率而非漂移稳定了校准市场。在实测波动率下，该波在每十年都追踪了经验资本分布，决定了多样性加权投资组合的资本化增长，并将市场置于多样性相边界之内。换手率回收了再平衡收益的大部分。
tldr: 本文通过反应-扩散方程建模股票市场中的排名依赖进入与退出，发现换手率（而非漂移）稳定市场，并预测行波追踪资本分布，对多样性投资组合有重要影响。
en_tdlr: This paper models rank-based entry and exit in equity markets via reaction-diffusion equations, showing that turnover, not drift, stabilizes markets and the traveling wave tracks empirical capital distributions, significantly impacting diversity-weighted portfolios.
